newsitem.title: USA: State Street wins $21.5 mln Georgetown, Mass. BANs.
newsitem.headline: State Street wins $21.5 mln Georgetown, Mass. BANs.

text.p: State Street Bank said it won $21.56 million of Georgetown, Mass., bond anticipation notes (BANs).

State Street won $11.5 million of the notes with a 4 percent coupon and a 3.857 percent net interest cost (NIC); $5 million of the notes with a 4 percent coupon and a 3.829 percentnet interest cost; and $5 million of the notes with a 4 percent coupon and a 3.844 percent net interest cost. --U.S. Municipal Desk, 212-859-1650
